concept.title: Navigation-based Smart Cruise Control pause/driver operation

conbody.p: If Smart Cruise Control cannot operate because Smart Cruise Control is temporarily deactivated or the route is recalculated, etc, the gray () indicator appears on the instrument cluster.
If you have engaged the accelerator pedal, the white () indicator blinks on the instrument cluster.

li.p: Before entering a non-highway road or a highway rest area while Navigation-based Smart Cruise Control is operating.
A warning message appears when the Navigation-based Smart Cruise Control is not able to slow your vehicle to a safe speed.

note.p: The images or colors may display differently depending on the specifications of the instrument cluster or theme.
